# The Plant Based School

> > A family-friendly vegetarian and plant-based recipe site by Nico Pallotta and Louise Vestergaard, featuring quick meals with simple ingredients.

The Plant Based School offers veggie-packed, high-protein, and high-fiber recipes designed for families. Created by Nico and Louise from Todi, Italy, the site focuses on making plant-based cooking accessible with easy-to-follow recipes and practical meal ideas.

## Key Topics

- Vegetarian recipes
- Plant-based cooking
- Family meals
- Quick meals
- Vegan recipes
- High-protein recipes
- High-fiber recipes
- Veggie-packed meals
- Simple ingredients
- Nico Pallotta
- Louise Vestergaard
- Plant-based recipes
- Vegetable recipes
